# Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Male Dancer in an Off-Broadway Show

| sponsor = New York City Dance Alliance
}}
The Chita Rivera Award for Outstanding Male Dancer in an Off-Broadway Show was an annual award presented to a male dancer for their work on an Off-Broadway production. The award was added in the 2015-2016 season, the final year the awards were known as the Fred and Adele Astaire Awards.
The award was established in 2016, and was subsequently replaced by the gender-neutral Outstanding Dancers in an Off-Broadway Show in 2023.
